name: route_intent
description: Classify launcher input text to pick the next action suggestion. Call this for EVERY input; never stay silent. Rule 1: if the input is written IN CHINESE (中文), the intent is ask_ai - Chinese is the user's own language, NEVER translate it. Rule 2: translate only for a NON-CHINESE foreign-language sentence (English/Japanese/...) or an explicit 翻译/fanyi/translate request. Rule 3: open_url only for web URLs (http/https); open_path only for file system paths (C:\dir\file.ext, \\server\share, /usr/bin). Rule 4: none for app names, search keywords, code identifiers, commands, emails, UUIDs, colors, IPs.
